_comment: The Jarvis stack, in start order. Single source of truth for every launcher: start-all.ps1 and start-jarvis.ps1 read it through service-list.ps1, and the desktop Control Center reads it directly. 'wait' is the pause before the NEXT service starts - Eureka needs a head start so the rest register cleanly, and the gateway is last so it waits for nobody.
_dependencies: Not ours to start - they run outside the stack - but everything here depends on them. Postgres missing means every service fails its first migration, so it is required; Ollama missing only costs the AI features.

dependencies.name: ollama
dependencies.label: Ollama
